looks.label: armoured knight
looks.summary: An armoured knight with a cape and a visored helmet, rigged, with clips to stand, walk, run, reach to the ground, hold a thing up and sit.

joints.root: the rig's own root below the hips; the body plan starts at the hips, so it stays in the figure and moves with its clips
joints.hand.l: a palm joint past the wrist; the body plan's left hand is the wrist joint, so this stays in the figure and moves with its clips
joints.hand.r: a palm joint past the wrist; the body plan's right hand is the wrist joint, so this stays in the figure and moves with its clips

clips.Idle_B: one idle clip is kept; this is a second idle
clips.Interact: a push with one hand at chest height; no motion of a person's body is drawn with it
clips.Spawn_Air: things arrive by the world's rules, never by a clip
clips.Spawn_Ground: things arrive by the world's rules, never by a clip
clips.T-Pose: the figure's own rest pose is kept; a clip of it adds nothing
clips.Use_Item: no motion of a person's body is drawn with it
clips.Running_B: one run clip is kept; this is a second run
clips.Walking_B: one walk clip is kept; this is another walk
clips.Walking_C: one walk clip is kept; this is another walk
clips.Holding_B: one holding clip is kept; this one holds a thing across the body
clips.Holding_C: one holding clip is kept; this one holds a thing across the body
clips.Sit_Chair_Down: the movement into a seat; the world blends from standing to sitting
clips.Sit_Chair_StandUp: the movement out of a seat; the world blends from sitting to standing
clips.Sit_Floor_Down: this world seats people on seats, not on the ground
clips.Sit_Floor_Idle: this world seats people on seats, not on the ground
clips.Sit_Floor_StandUp: this world seats people on seats, not on the ground
clips.Waving: a greeting is a line said, not a wave
clips.Cheering: a motion no ability here draws

files.Rig_Medium_Tools.glb: a tool or work motion; no ability here uses a tool
files.Rig_Medium_Simulation.glb: a motion no ability here draws
